doc.brief: The QGraphicsItemAnimation class provides simple animation support for [QGraphicsItem](xref:qt:QGraphicsItem).

QGraphicsItem * item() const.brief: Returns the item on which the animation object operates.

QGraphicsItemAnimation(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs an animation object with the given *parent*.

QPointF posAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the position of the item at the given *step* value.

QTimeLine * timeLine() const.brief: Returns the timeline object used to control the rate at which the animation occurs.

QTransform transformAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the transform used for the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal horizontalScaleAt(qreal step) cons.brief: Returns the horizontal scale for the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal horizontalShearAt(qreal step) cons.brief: Returns the horizontal shear for the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal rotationAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the angle at which the item is rotated at the specified *step* value.

qreal verticalScaleAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the vertical scale for the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal verticalShearAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the vertical shear for the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal xTranslationAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the horizontal translation of the item at the specified *step* value.

qreal yTranslationAt(qreal step) const.brief: Returns the vertical translation of the item at the specified *step* value.

void afterAnimationStep(qreal step).brief: This method is meant to be overridden in subclasses that need to execute additional code after a new step has taken place.

void beforeAnimationStep(qreal step).brief: This method is meant to be overridden by subclassed that needs to execute additional code before a new step takes place.

void clear().brief: Clears the scheduled transformations used for the animation, but retains the item and timeline.

void setItem(QGraphicsItem *item).brief: Sets the specified *item* to be used in the animation.

void setPosAt(qreal step, const QPointF.brief: Sets the position of the item at the given *step* value to the *point* specified.

void setRotationAt(qreal step, qreal ang.brief: Sets the rotation of the item at the given *step* value to the *angle* specified.

void setScaleAt(qreal step, qreal sx, qr.brief: Sets the scale of the item at the given *step* value using the horizontal and vertical scale factors specified by *sx* and *sy*.

void setShearAt(qreal step, qreal sh, qr.brief: Sets the shear of the item at the given *step* value using the horizontal and vertical shear factors specified by *sh* and *sv*.

void setStep(qreal step).brief: Sets the current *step* value for the animation, causing the transformations scheduled at this step to be performed.

void setTimeLine(QTimeLine *timeLine).brief: Sets the timeline object used to control the rate of animation to the *timeLine* specified.

void setTranslationAt(qreal step, qreal.brief: Sets the translation of the item at the given *step* value using the horizontal and vertical coordinates specified by *dx* and *dy*.
